scope: External freshness / anti-rollback checkpoint reference implementation
verified_scenarios: primary-only rollback to an older valid snapshot is detected while the latest anchor is intact
uncheckpointed state fails closed even when row-level HMACs remain valid
two concurrent checkpoint attempts sharing a parent head yield a single CAS winner
read-only CLI verification works without operator approval key
limitations: SQLiteReferenceAnchor is a local reference implementation, not a remote independent monotonic service
coordinated rollback of primary and anchor files is not detectable by this local adapter
operator HMAC demonstrates possession of a secret key, not human identity or authority
checkpoint publication is an offline/maintenance operation and not transactionally coupled to continuous service writes
no full upstream Lycheetah package/CI run
